context: Continuous career agent execution for candidate udaysagar_kandpal with negative company guardrails

reflections.user_intent: Launch continuous job application agent for Udaysagar Kandpal, inspect profile to answer dynamic chatbot questions, enforce strict negative company exclusions (Cognizant, CTS, Infosys, TCS), and approve remediation of discovery crash.
reflections.why_user_made_such_thinking: The user aims for high-precision autonomous job applications targeting high-value Java Lead/Architect roles in Bangalore without polluting applications with service-based employers where candidate is employed or has prior history.
reflections.why_user_performed_this_way: The user gave clear operating constraints upfront and authorized the bugfix immediately upon diagnostic reporting, adhering to Developer Mode Gatekeeping protocol.
reflections.user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Direct approval of the patch with explicit instruction to ensure accurate role discovery and application.
reflections.did_ai_actually_understand: Yes. Thoroughly analyzed resume.md, candidate_config.json, verified negative keywords/companies, fixed dictionary skill flattening bug cleanly, and monitored pending_question.json IPC real-time.
reflections.was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. Continuous daemon started, runtime crash resolved upon approval, IPC question handled immediately, and negative company jobs actively rejected at runtime.
reflections.evolutionary_takeaways: Taxonomy skills structures in candidate_config.json can contain heterogeneous types (lists of strings and lists of dictionaries like naukri_it_skills). System-level parsing must defensively handle nested object models.
